description: Due-diligence report on a website, merchant or counterparty domain: registrable domain, registry RDAP facts (registrar, abuse contact, created, expiry, age, status, nameservers), DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA) from Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS, SPF and DMARC posture, a live web probe (redirect chain, HTTPS, HSTS, site-supplied title, parked or for-sale signs), brand-impersonation checks, and a 0-100 risk score with transparent weighted signals and a verdict. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

domain.description: Bare domain, hostname, email address or URL. Scheme, path, port and credentials are stripped and IDNs are converted to punycode. IP addresses and private names are rejected.
